feeds.title: ConservaMom
feeds.description: Hi! I am Elia. Conservamom is all about Conserving Mom's Time, Money & Sanity. I love checking out the newest products for kids, family, and home. Follow my adventures of raising 6 active kids, with a bit of Hispanic Flair, laughs, love, and fun.

feeds.title: Raising Arrows
feeds.description: I'm Amy, mom to 10 arrows! Raising Arrows is the ultimate resource for large family homeschooling and homemaking. As my family grew, my blog grew, and now Raising Arrows is considered the go-to resource for homeschooling multiple ages! I am humbled and honored to be considered an expert in the large family homeschooling and homemaking world, and I am passionate about helping other moms become experts too!

feeds.title: Raising Lifelong Learners Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Colleen, gifted specialist, educational consultant, author, speaker, and homeschool mom of four gifted/twice-exceptional kids. I help families like yours trust themselves to embrace the adventure of a delight-directed approach to education with lessons, challenges, tips, classes, and a community of like-minded kids and their parents.

feeds.title: Flanders Family Homelife Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jennifer mother of 12 children. I have been married to my husband, Doug, for 30 years. We started this blog as a way to share resources with others who want strong marriages, happy families, & healthy homes.

feeds.title: Big Family Little Adventures
feeds.description: Big Family Little Adventures is a Days Out and Family Travel Blog for the larger-than-average family. If you have a Big Family you will know the difficulties, and we aim to offer practical ideas to overcoming these and ensuring Holidays and Days out become childhood memories they will treasure.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Wonders
feeds.description: I, Nikki Turner-Chaplin, am a member of the Yorkshire Wonders UK family. Yorkshire Wonders is a page dedicated to reviewing the lifestyle, family days out, home gardens, and families travel.

feeds.title: The Character Corner Blog
feeds.description: Visit The Character Corner Blog for encouragement and practical help in raising kids with godly character. Learn to parent purposefully today. I'm Kathie, wife to Alan, mother of eight children, and homeschooling mom of 31 years. On my site and blog I will share many of the things the Lord has taught me, as well as provide information and resources to help you to not only focus on the academics, but the more important issues of the relationship with your kids, character training, and pointing them to God.

feeds.title: Simple Living Mama
feeds.description: Hi! I am Joanie Boeckman the author of Simple Living Mama. My goal here at Simple Living Mama is to empower women in their roles as homemakers, mothers, and homeschool teachers. I strive to teach women how to create a nurturing home, how to create loving relationships with their children, and how to home educate their children.

feeds.title: The European Large Families Confederation
feeds.description: Read news, information, contacts, and rights of large families in the European countries.(ELFAC) was formally constituted in 2004, gathering Large Family Associations across Europe. The objectives of the Confederation is to represent the social and economic interests of families with children, in general, and large families,

feeds.title: Janelle Knutson Blog
feeds.description: I'm Janelle Knutson, wife and homeschool mom to seven children. I'm also a homeschool blogger, YouTuber, podcaster, homeschool consultant, and speaker. My desire is to encourage homeschool moms with practical tips and biblical truth. My greatest joy is found in Christ and it is my desire to share that joy with others.

feeds.title: Messy Mom
feeds.description: My family of 6 lives in a small space in Cincinnati, Ohio. It can certainly get interesting with my crazy messy clan. Follow along to know how I make the best of what looks like a mess.

feeds.title: AppleHurst
feeds.description: We are a large family of 8 children, ranging in age from 21 to 4. At AppleHurst we share our experiences about our large family living lifestyle, family funnies, homeschooling, blessings, gratitude food and recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Mom Delights » Large Family Life
feeds.description: MomDelights' Large Family Life blog category shares faith‑centered advice, encouragement, and practical insights from a seasoned mom of 15 on topics like homeschooling, family organization, and large‑family living.

feeds.title: Plain and not so plain
feeds.description: PlainAndNotSoPlain.com is a personal blog by Amy, documenting life in a large Christian homeschooling family while sharing free resources, simple homemaking tips, baking recipes, and encouragement rooted in faith and simplicity.

feeds.title: Large Family Arrow Blog
feeds.description: Empowering Christian homeschool moms through faith, family, and education with a showcased touch.

feeds.title: The Muchness Mama » Large Family Life
feeds.description: Large Blended Family Life

feeds.title: The Duggar Family
feeds.description: The Duggar Family pubishes articles on Family News. In our family, love most assuredly multiplies. Duggar-style multiplication includes not only more children but also new adventures, unexpected challenges, and ongoing creativity.

feeds.title: Crazy Family Adventure
feeds.description: Hi! We are Craig and Bryanna. We are a family of 6. We hope you will join us on our Crazy Family Adventure- as we unschool our kids, learn how to live in an RV, and continue to aim at peacefully and joyfully raising our kids! While spreading the word that you can deepen your family bond through travel!

feeds.title: A Mother Far From Home
feeds.description: Hi, Rachel Norman here. It is such an honor to hear from you and share part of our motherhood journey. We uncomplicate family life by giving moms practical strategies around routines, discipline, baby sleep, boundaries for mothers, and more.

feeds.title: Rad Family Travel
feeds.description: Our Colorado family shares favorite travel destinations and best places to go in the USA and all over the world. Vacations filled with outdoor recreation and adventure, US national parks, cities, road trips, resorts, camping, and more with kids and teens. Big family travel tips plus things to do, where to stay and eat - we've got you covered.

feeds.title: Little Earthling Blog
feeds.description: My name is Renee and I am an American minimalist who married a Canadian pack rack. We have 14 kids and three beautiful grandsons and a granddaughter. I write about minimizing chaos and clutter, an organization for large families, raising kids with special needs, homeschooling, and how to feed a large family, and my favorite kitchen hacks and recipes.

feeds.title: A Genealogy Journal
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Phyllis Winike Zeck, I always had an interest in our family genealogy. I am part of a large Italian family; one of eight children. A Genealogy Journal, my blog, is about tracing my Italian ancestors. The blog features amazing articles related to family genealogy.

feeds.title: Medium Sized Family
feeds.description: Medium-Sized Family discusses and shares articles about large family budgets, helping you build your savings, even when life is frustrating. I'm Jamie, our family of 8 enjoys taking guilt-free trips. We're building a stronger savings account.

feeds.title: Kellogg Show Blog
feeds.description: We are the KelloggShow, a homeschool, a traveling family of 14 strong, and a legit family filled with legit adventure junkies. We find our joy in waking people up from the dead and showing them how to LIVE their best life and make it exciting.

feeds.title: Bontrager Family Singers Blog
feeds.description: The Bontrager Family Singers features articles about large family lifestyles and their singing passion. The Bontrager Family Singers is a tight-knit, energetic family from the midwest. We love to sing, play our instruments, and shine the light of Jesus! In addition to our tour life, we lead an adventurous & high-energy life back in Iowa.

feeds.title: Nourishing Goodness Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ashley. Welcome to Nourishing Goodness, a place where you'll find practical tips and inspiration for: Sustainable Homesteading, Charlotte Mason Homeschooling, Large Family Life, Nourishing, Whole Foods, & Natural Remedies to the Glory of God!

feeds.title: Family Centered Life
feeds.description: Family-Centered Life is a culmination of my parenting experiences and my experience as a clinical ps. HI! I'm Dr. Melissa Jones. I'm a clinical psychologist who focuses on serving children and families at my private practice. We focus on family issues that impact all of us, such as parenting struggles, self-care, family fun, and strengthening family bonds.

feeds.title: Rising Dough and Raising Kids
feeds.description: Rising Dough and Raising Kids feature amazing articles about Large family living, homeschooling, raising kids, and more. I am Stephanie, married to the most supportive man I have ever met and we have an extra-large family. We are the proud parents of 7 kids. We try to do everything we can at home. Cooking, gardening, working, and school are all done at home whenever possible

feeds.title: Homeschooling Large Family Style
feeds.description: Hi! I am Tristan, I'm a wife of 20 years to one good man, and mother to 10 sweet children. We homeschool, pray, play, and grow together one busy day at a time.At Homeschooling Large Family Style you can read read articles about Large family living.

feeds.title: Mama in the Trenches » Large Family
feeds.description: Mama in the Trenches' Large Family category shares heartwarming, faith‑rooted stories and practical homemaking of a Christian mama raising many, homeschooling, and building home from scratch.

feeds.title: I Choose Joy
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Gena, the mom of eight children, ages 21 down to 9. I have homeschooled them from the very beginning. My blog is a place to share my joy in my family, in my home, reviewing helpful homeschooling materials so you can make informed decisions, providing tips for homemaking, and sharing about our everyday life.

feeds.title: Thrifty Nifty Mommy
feeds.description: At Thrifty Nifty Mommy, you'll find posts about affordable family life, nifty ideas, motherhood, recipes, homeschooling, parenting tips and humor, giveaways, & product reviews.

feeds.title: The House O'Neill
feeds.description: We are the O'Neill family- Niall, Rachel, and our four rambunctious children. We want our children to know the Lord and observe their parents living a vibrant, loving, working faith. Our goal is to equip parents who love Jesus with simple, helpful resources about parenting, large family raising, and more.
